categories.main_business_segments: EPAM operates primarily through two reportable segments: North America and Europe, following the sale of its Russia segment in 2023. These segments are organized by managerial responsibility for client relationships, which generally align with client geographic locations. The company delivers a comprehensive suite of digital engineering, cloud, AI-enabled transformation services, and business and experience consulting across these regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: EPAM's core capabilities are rooted in software engineering, agile methodologies, and proprietary global delivery platforms. The company leverages advanced technologies including cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI), data analytics, cybersecurity, and customer experience design. Its multidisciplinary teams use custom tools, repeatable frameworks, and engineering excellence practices to deliver end-to-end digital transformation solutions, including product development, platform modernization, and managed services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EPAM serves a geographically diverse client base, focusing on large enterprises and ambitious startups across five main industry verticals: Financial Services, Consumer Goods/Retail/Travel, Software & Hi-Tech, Business Information & Media, and Life Sciences & Healthcare. The company also targets emerging verticals such as energy, telecommunications, education, real estate, industrial materials, automotive, manufacturing, and government entities.
categories.geographic_coverage: EPAM operates globally, with its largest client markets in the Americas (especially the United States), EMEA (notably the UK, Switzerland, and Germany), and APAC. Its delivery centers are strategically located worldwide, with significant operations in India, Ukraine, Poland, Mexico, and Belarus. The company continues to expand its presence in Latin America and Europe through acquisitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: EPAM operates as a downstream provider in the IT and digital transformation value chain, delivering consulting, engineering, and managed services directly to end clients. It acts as a strategic partner, integrating technology and business solutions for organizations seeking digital transformation and innovation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: EPAM's strategic priorities center on expanding its digital engineering, cloud, and AI/GenAI capabilities, deepening industry specialization, and broadening its consulting and experience design offerings. The company invests heavily in R&D, innovation labs, proprietary platforms (such as EPAM AI/RUN™), and continuous employee learning, with a focus on integrating advanced technologies and supporting clients' digital modernization and transformation initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: EPAM generates the majority of its revenue through professional services billed on a time-and-materials or fixed-price basis, with a small portion from licensing and other revenues. Its contracts typically involve software engineering, consulting, and managed services, with revenues recognized as services are delivered or upon achievement of contractual milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EPAM competes with global technology solutions providers (e.g., Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte Digital, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro), specialized consulting firms, boutique digital agencies, and regional outsourcing companies. The company is recognized as a leader in complex, innovative software product development and digital transformation, with a reputation for technical excellence and high-quality delivery.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, EPAM reported revenues of $4.73 billion, with a net income of $454.5 million and approximately 61,200 employees. Revenue growth was modest at 0.8% year-over-year, reflecting stabilization after prior periods of rapid expansion and recent macroeconomic and geopolitical challenges. The company maintains a strong balance sheet, significant cash reserves, and continues to invest in acquisitions and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EPAM differentiates itself through deep engineering expertise, integrated strategy and consulting, proprietary global delivery platforms, and a focus on complex, end-to-end digital transformation. Its multidisciplinary teams, agile methodologies, and commitment to innovation enable clients to accelerate time-to-market, unlock new business models, and achieve sustained competitive advantage. The company emphasizes long-term partnerships, quality, and the ability to deliver tailored, scalable solutions across industries and geographies.
